title: Cafecito, pan dulce and monarchs: Merienda de la Monarca comes to Las Palmas Park this Sunday
excerpt: The Merienda de la Monarca brings monarch butterfly activities, cafecito and pan dulce to Las Palmas Nature Trail Park (519 Water St.) on Sunday, Oct. 25, from 3 to 5 p.m.
content:
Laredo families are invited to a sweet Sunday afternoon under the trees this weekend. The Merienda de la Monarca — a community merienda celebrating the monarch butterfly migration — takes place Sunday, October 25, from 3:00 to 5:00 p.m. at Las Palmas Nature Trail Park, 519 Water St. in Laredo.

The gathering is presented by the Rio Grande International Study Center (RGISC) and Comparte Laredo, according to the event flyer. Organizers are billing it as an afternoon to "celebrate nature, culture & community" with fun monarch butterfly activities for the family, plus cafecito and pan dulce.

The timing is no accident. Every fall, monarch butterflies funnel south through Texas and the Rio Grande corridor on their long migration to their overwintering grounds in central Mexico, and late October is prime monarch season in the Laredo area. Events like the Merienda de la Monarca give border families a front-row seat to one of nature's great journeys — right in the middle of one of the region's most scenic riverfront parks.

The event is weather permitting, and organizers note it may be affected by weather conditions. For more information, call (956) 718-1063 or visit the event's Facebook page.

Sources: Merienda de la Monarca event flyer and Facebook event page, Rio Grande International Study Center (RGISC) and Comparte Laredo.
